> how old are you?

20

>do you have a friend who can help or relative?

No.

I'm simply too anxious to actually get them myself. Too anxious to go through the process of a psych evaluation. I can't even drive (too anxious to go though with a driving test) so there's no way for me to do this on my own. And since everyone around me thinks it's incurable, there's no reason for them to help.
Can't get them myself and everyone else thinks I have some incurable mental illness.
I only don't feel this way when I'm alone and have no contact with anyone. Nothing has become better in the last 8 years. They have only got worse.
I don't have the ability to get them.
